description: This file provides order-related services including fetching, creating, normalizing, and updating orders, with support for backend API interaction and mock data fallback. It also includes utility functions for order status management, payment summaries, and credit notes handling.

methods.name: detectBackendAvailable
methods.description: Checks if backend API for orders is available, caches result for session.

methods.name: normalizeProduct
methods.description: Normalizes product object to include stock quantity and in-stock status.

methods.name: normalizeOrderItems
methods.description: Normalizes an array of order items, assigning IDs and normalizing products.

methods.name: maskUpi
methods.description: Masks UPI ID for privacy, showing only first two characters of local part.

methods.name: paymentSummaryShort
methods.description: Generates a short summary string for a payment method.

methods.name: normalizeOrder
methods.description: Normalizes an order object, setting default values and formatting.

methods.name: normalizeOrders
methods.description: Normalizes a list of orders.

methods.name: readLocalOrders
methods.description: Reads mock orders from local storage.

methods.name: writeLocalOrders
methods.description: Writes mock orders to local storage.

methods.name: buildMockOrders
methods.description: Creates mock order data for offline or development use.

methods.name: getPastOrders
methods.description: Fetches orders from backend if available, otherwise returns mock orders.

methods.name: getOrderById
methods.description: Fetches a specific order by ID from backend or mock data.

methods.name: getFrequentItems
methods.description: Returns products sorted by frequency across past orders.

methods.name: isBackendMode
methods.description: Returns true if backend orders API is detected.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order, attempting backend API call or storing in local storage for mock.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Wrapper for getPastOrders, returns list of orders.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Wrapper for getOrderById, returns a single order.

methods.name: advanceStatus
methods.description: Advances order status to next in sequence; mock-only, no backend support.

methods.name: addCreditNote
methods.description: Adds a mock credit note for an order, stored in local storage.

methods.name: getCreditNotes
methods.description: Retrieves credit notes for an order from local storage.
